Same character height320px, mask-to-sole scale constant, feet soles y450 in each512px-tall row, stance center at cellx192. Wide blank gutters32px minimum. Row1: four successive breathing idle frames facingRIGHT in three-quarter side combat stance. Row2: four breathing idle frames facingLEFT, independently drawn view of OTHER side, not a mirrored flipped image. Keep anatomical LEFT shoulder cannon and RIGHT wrist blades attached correctly. Same silver smooth 1987 mask, yellow mottled skin and netting, metal ring dreadlocks, asymmetric bronze armor and brownloincloth as reference. Feet planted at identical stance/pivots, subtle chest/shoulder/forearm breathing cycle and hair secondary movement, actual distinct drawings not duplicate copies. Crisp 2D pixelart intended180pixel-tall combat rendering. No added weapons.

Create a production spritesheet: 4 equal columns by 4 equal rows, exactly 16 separate full-body drawings. Portrait canvas 1024x1536, each cell exactly 256x384. Genuine transparent RGBA background everywhere outside silhouettes, no shadows, no checkerboard, no grid, no writing, no numbers. Every cell entirely contains exactly one identical character at consistent scale, soles at cell y=354, body crown around y=36, pelvis near cell x=128. Adequate padding, no spill into neighboring cells. Three-quarter fighting side view facing RIGHT in all frames. Whole-body pixel art clean finely shaded 2D sprite, crisp readable silhouette suitable for rendering 180px tall. No smooth interpolated copies: actually draw successive poses and limb changes; consistent anatomy and equipment, 5 digits if visible, two arms/two legs, hands attached and coherent.
Row1 columns1-4: calm combat-ready breathing cycle, two bent knees, wrists held ready, subtle chest/shoulder/dreadlock changes, feet planted; four distinct drawings that loop naturally.
Row2 columns1-4: walking forward fighting cycle facing right, alternating foot plant/passing positions with two distinct legs and weight transfer. No sliding pose duplicates.
Row3 columns1-4: standing fast wrist-blade light attack: clear anticipation arms drawn back; active extension towards RIGHT with wrist blades and correct attached hand; follow-through; recovery near ready. Keep feet within cell, do not enlarge weapons, no detached trails.
Row4 columns1-2: high guard standing with forearms raised protecting mask, guard brace variation. Columns3-4: standing hit recoil backward then recovering, equipment unchanged and coherent.
No extra weapons, staff, gun, disc, text, cropped feet, malformed hands or graphic violence. Identity must remain same across all 16 cells. Output is one usable sprite atlas, not a presentation collage.
